# NCAAF Tuesday MACtion - Nov 10

- Ohio at Miami (OH) (8 PM): market flipped from Miami -1.5 to Ohio -1.5 with 83% of money on Ohio. Dimers Miami 51.6% (Miami +1.5 at 54.8%); WagerTalk Ohio 27-20. Miami down to third QB Caleb Heavner (McComb, Gotkowski out for season). Split - pass. Lean Ohio (fade the depleted QB room).
- Kent State at Bowling Green (7 PM): BG -6, total 44.5. Dimers BG 65% (~5.5) and Over 44.5 (53.9%); WagerTalk BG 24-17 and Under; 91% of spread money on Kent State but line moved to BG. Split on the total; side on the number. Pass.
- Akron at Western Michigan (7 PM): WMU -13.5, Dimers 84.3% (~13). On the number. Pass.
